WITH none AS (SELECT NULL AS account_id FROM UNNEST([]) )
SELECT
    dim_account.segment_name  AS dim_account_segment_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(orders_current.gross_order_amount ), 0) AS orders_current_gross_order_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(orders_prior.gross_order_amount ), 0) AS orders_prior_gross_order_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(plans_current.plan_count ), 0) AS plans_current_plan_count,
    MIN(plans_current.month_id) || [Redacted string] || MAX(plans_current.month_id)  AS plans_current_month_range,
    COALESCE(SUM(plans_prior.plan_count ), 0) AS plans_prior_plan_count,
    MIN(plans_prior.month_id) || [Redacted string] || MAX(plans_prior.month_id)  AS plans_prior_month_range
FROM none
FULL OUTER JOIN (
      SELECT * FROM `my_dataset.orders_monthly_summary` 
      WHERE order_date >= DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), MONTH), INTERVAL -3 MONTH)
        AND order_date <= DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), MONTH), INTERVAL -3 MONTH), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
    ) AS orders_current ON FALSE
FULL OUTER JOIN (
      SELECT * FROM `my_dataset.orders_monthly_summary` 
      WHERE order_date >= DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), MONTH), INTERVAL -15 MONTH)
        AND order_date <= DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), MONTH), INTERVAL -15 MONTH), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
    ) AS orders_prior ON FALSE
FULL OUTER JOIN (
      SELECT * FROM `my_dataset.plans_monthly_summary` 
      WHERE plan_date >= DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), MONTH), INTERVAL -3 MONTH)
        AND plan_date <= DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), MONTH), INTERVAL -3 MONTH), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
    ) AS plans_current ON FALSE
FULL OUTER JOIN (
      SELECT * FROM `my_dataset.plans_monthly_summary` 
      WHERE plan_date >= DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), MONTH), INTERVAL -15 MONTH)
        AND plan_date <= DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), MONTH), INTERVAL -15 MONTH), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
    ) AS plans_prior ON FALSE
LEFT JOIN `my_dataset.dim_accounts`  AS dim_account ON dim_account.account_id = COALESCE(
      NULL
      , orders_current.account_id 
      , orders_prior.account_id   
      , plans_current.account_id   
      , plans_prior.account_id     
    )
CROSS JOIN UNNEST([COALESCE(
      CAST(NULL AS DATE)
        , orders_current.order_date 
        , plans_current.plan_date 
      )]) AS date
CROSS JOIN UNNEST([COALESCE(
      CAST(NULL AS DATE)
        , orders_prior.order_date 
        , plans_prior.plan_date   
      )]) AS date_prior
WHERE (COALESCE(((( date ) >= ((DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), MONTH), INTERVAL -3 MONTH))) AND ( date ) < ((DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), MONTH), INTERVAL -3 MONTH), INTERVAL 3 MONTH))))),TRUE)) AND (COALESCE(((( date_prior ) >= ((DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), MONTH), INTERVAL -15 MONTH))) AND ( date_prior ) < ((DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), MONTH), INTERVAL -15 MONTH), INTERVAL 3 MONTH))))),TRUE))
GROUP BY
    1
ORDER BY
    2 DESC
LIMIT 500
